fixes.explanation: Harvest is in this passage, in verse 9, with grain and grapes. But the message for Daughter Zion in verse 11 is something else. It says, “See, your Savior comes!” The one coming is the Savior.

Kings do get a mention in this passage, in verse 2, where they see Zion's glory. But the word in verse 10 is not kings. It says, “Go out, go out through the gates; prepare the way for the people!” The people are the ones named.
